introHtml: With hood tank tops combine the coverage of a hoodie with the breathability of a tank top, making them ideal for outdoor events, sports teams, or casual giveaways. The added hood offers sun protection and a sporty look that stands out from standard tank tops. Decorate the front or back with screen printing or embroidery for a functional, branded garment your recipients will reach for all season long.
